items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Elmer Fain has been around Los Angeles -- he was here when I first came here

ctx.x: They all know him and they --

Yes, indeed, and it's been like that through the years. Well, he was here when I first came here, and guys like -- well, Elmer Fain, who we mentioned earlier. Elmer Fain has been around Los Angeles -- he was here when I first came here, and later I think Elmer Fain might have had an orchestra at that time. I don't remember. But later, Elmer Fain became a business agent for the black union, local 767.
And now he's the business agent for 47.
